hero.title: Three laptops running a GitOps k3s cluster.
hero.blurb: A three-node k3s homelab built in public. Every change ships from git through Flux, apps reach the internet through a Cloudflare Tunnel with no open router ports, and Prometheus watches every node. Below: how it's wired, what broke along the way, the decisions I made and why, and what's next.

contact.name: Craven Craven
contact.headline: Open to DevOps and SRE roles.
contact.line: Happy to walk through the cluster live and show you how a change gets from git to running.
